scenes.text: An octopus has three hearts, and its blood is blue.
Two of the hearts pump blood through the gills to pick up oxygen.
The third heart sends that blood to the rest of the body.
But when an octopus swims, that third heart stops beating.
That's why octopuses would rather crawl, because swimming tires them out.
Their blood is blue because it uses copper instead of iron to carry oxygen.
Which sea creature should we cover next?

title: Octopuses have 3 hearts and blue blood 🐙
caption: Two hearts pump blood through the gills, and the third pumps it to the body, but it stops when the octopus swims! Their blood is blue because it uses copper-based hemocyanin instead of iron.
